name: Nishikawa Keisoku Co., Ltd.
summary: Nishikawa Keisoku Co., Ltd. sells control and information equipment systems and measuring instruments in Japan. The company also provides scientific and chemical equipment, industrial equipment, and other products, as well as engineering, software development, instrumentation work, and maintenance services for related products. In addition, it offers plants; physical and chemical; measurement; automotive and new energy solutions; optical and wireless communication solutions. It serves water and sewerage, energy, chemicals, food, pharmaceuticals, automobiles, semiconductors, and services industries. Nishikawa Keisoku Co., Ltd. was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
